scope: Standalone POS prototype foundations; test data only. No new real card, cash or Bitcoin payment was processed.

groups: atomic event journal, retention, replay and uncertain writes

history_cases: cash tender filter returns one of three saved test sales
filter retained after receipt and back
unknown item search yields no matching sales
clear resets filters and returns all three
saved cash receipt reopened on final APK
android.receipt_copy: Explicit action executed without app error; formatter payload checked by JVM tests. Clipboard contents were not independently extracted.
android.square_scope: Final module built offline against shared checkout code and native libraries. No additional SDK payment executed in this milestone.

limits: Prototype sample catalog has two items, not catalog administration or tax/modifier engine
Cash is USD-only and manually acknowledged; no drawer control, shift closeout or cash refunds
Event journal is local checkout API only and requires explicit initialization; no webhook transport or owner Requests journal
Event snapshots contain full sale records and require a local authorization boundary before exposure
Capability policy evaluates verified metadata; it does not authenticate credentials or implement staff accounts
UTXO maintenance is advisory, not automatic signing or consolidation
Lightning assessment is a point-in-time capacity signal, not a route, liquidity or recovery guarantee
Backup failure test uses synthetic local directory blobs, not actual Box or complete LDK monitor recovery
No full POS, production card or real-funds readiness claim
